title: Fellow Devs! My first demo for my fishing game is free and ready. Go break it.
author: BSwayzeYo
selftext:
Hey friends!  
Please grab my game, test it, break it, catch fish, ask questions, tell me what you love, what you hate, what you wish was included...

**What's built with AI in my game?**  
The Code, Lure Textures, Fish Textures, Character Sprites, Music

**What's NOT?**  
World environment tile sets - Purchased ManaSeed. ManaSeed is awesome! I placed all of these with intention.  
All UI elements were made by me.  
Sound Effects  
Clouds

**The Tech Stack:**

**AI Assisted:** Code (Godot 4.6 + Claude), Lure/Fish/Character Sprites, Music.

**Hand-Curated:** World Environment (ManaSeed assets, hand-placed), All UI (Canva), Sound FX, Clouds.

  
Ask me anything about the tech and I'll gladly share!  
Love this community!

**The "First" Milestone:** The "Demo" buoy line bobbers are my first-ever hand-drawn pixel art!

[https://beaverspondbac.itch.io/beavers-pond-bass-country](https://beaverspondbac.itch.io/beavers-pond-bass-country)

  
[https://www.youtube.com/@BeaversPondBassCountry](https://www.youtube.com/@BeaversPondBassCountry)

Only the female angler is available currently. I wanted to get this in your hands and get that all important feedback so I know what to focus on from here.

  
More sound design is coming!

If you find a bug or something feels 'off,' drop a comment here, on the youtube channel, or on the Itch page. I’m especially looking for feedback on the game loop.

  
Thanks a TON for any time you spend in Beaver's Pond.

Brian Carlson  
Creator of Beaver's Pond: Bass Country  
SoloDev - Dreamer - Wandering Soul

comments.author: MakkoMakkerton
comments.body: Looks pretty cool man, great job. One question for ya, why go with a pre-packed tile set over using AI to generate your own?

replies.author: BSwayzeYo
replies.body:
Thank you! I didn’t understand how tile sets work when I started this project.
I have since tried a few times to make some shoreline tile sets with AI, but thus far it’s been unsuccessful.
AI HATES to center images and also hates to draw things perfectly “flat”, so when I DO try this, it never creates a 9 tile grid that will snap together perfectly when being placed. Also, it doesn’t seem to understand how to do water tiles that will snap together seamlessly.
And truly, generating ai art isn’t just a magic bullet, which I’m sure you know, so… it saved a TON of time to buy them.
In the end, I was happy to support an artist though. Since it was something I could fit in my budget I was glad to pay. 🐡🎣
